turns.text: Hi Sofia! Happy Sunday. How's everything going? Did you get a chance to do any sourdough baking this weekend, or are you just relaxing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! I actually have some dough rising right now, but mostly I've just been relaxing. Since it's my day off from the clinic, I didn't have to do any driving or commuting today, which has been amazing.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A totally commute-free Sunday is the absolute best. It really lets you slow down. How did you kick off your morning?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I decided to treat myself and made a big, warm mug of hot cocoa. I know my roommate's been using that new espresso machine constantly, but I was in the mood for something sweet and comforting.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, hot cocoa sounds perfect for a cozy morning. Did you have any background entertainment going while you drank it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I put on a comedy podcast where two stand-up comedians talk about ridiculous internet drama. I usually listen to that true-crime one my coworker suggested, but I really just wanted a good laugh today.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Laughter is a great way to start the day. Did you end up making something good for lunch too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I assembled a homemade burrito bowl with some leftover rice, seasoned black beans, salsa, and avocado. It was delicious and took almost no effort.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious and so satisfying. Are you and Tom up to anything else today, or is it a purely lazy Sunday?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Very lazy. Dash is currently sleeping right across my lap, so I can't really move even if I wanted to! We might look at some summer wedding venue ideas later, but that's about it.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: You definitely can't disturb a sleeping greyhound! That is a very valid excuse to stay on the couch. How is your Italian course coming along in your free time?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's going pretty well! I'm trying to practice a little bit every couple of days. It's a lot of fun, though my pronunciation probably needs some work.
